platforms.description: One draft per platform, each with a different angle.

source_text.description: Pasted source content (blog post, notes). Cited as input:source_text. Without it, the source is the output of the steps this one depends on.

voice_profile.description: The author's voice as a written guide, usually content-voice-profile's profile_markdown kept in a document. Style only, never facts. Wins over voice_samples.

voice_samples.description: Earlier posts by the author, 3-10 recommended, used only when there is no voice profile. Style only, never facts. None of profile, document or samples: the house voice, noted in report.unknowns.

style_rules.description: Your own rules; they win over the voice and the defaults.

structure.description: Your post template, e.g. 'hook / the problem / what we did / one number / takeaway'.

emoji_level.description: none, light (<=2 LinkedIn, <=1 X, never in the hook) or medium (<=5 LinkedIn, <=2 X). Absent: follow the voice, else none.

angle_hint.description: A steer for the first platform's angle, e.g. 'the customer story'.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta. Optional: without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.
